meta.notice: Real TerraAnalog AI research outputs. Scores rank relative analog fidelity for one mission objective; they are not a measure of planetary equivalence.
meta.criteria_design: Criteria are reference-specific ('<REF_ID>.<feature>', value = 5 x similarity). body_weights pick the body, reference_multipliers zero the other references of the same body, objective multipliers are TerraAnalog mission-profile weights. With these, the app's live score equals TerraAnalog's published fidelity for that (reference, profile).
meta.operational_separation: operational_suitability has weight 0 in every body/objective, so it never enters fidelity.

criteria.label: Lithology match - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'lithology' (jaccard).

criteria.label: Process match - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'process' (jaccard). covers volcanic / impact / aqueous / periglacial process similarity

criteria.label: Landform match - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'landform' (jaccard).

criteria.label: Resource match - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'resource' (jaccard).

criteria.label: Slope similarity - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'slope' (gaussian_pair). sim = 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dmed/4)^2) + 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dp90/6)^2); slopes compared at matched DEM baselines (Moon refs 80-118 m DEM vs Earth 90 m grid; Mars 463 m vs Earth 450 m grid)

criteria.label: Ruggedness (TRI) similarity - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'ruggedness' (log_ratio). sim = exp(-|ln(TRI_earth/TRI_ref)|), i.e. 0.5 at a factor-2 difference

criteria.label: Thermal similarity - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'thermal' (gaussian). Earth: CHELSA bio1 (fallback ERA5 mean) for surface sites; for lava-tube references the Earth value is the same air-temperature normal used as a proxy for cave interior temperature (documented approximation). Ref: literature/modeled mean surface temperature.

criteria.label: Aridity - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'aridity' (aridity_combined). References have no liquid precipitation (AI = 0, P = 0). sim = 0.5*sim_AI + 0.5*sim_P with sim_AI = 1 if AI<=0.05 (UNEP hyper-arid) else exp(-(AI-0.05)/0.15) and sim_P = 1 if P<=50 mm/yr else exp(-(P-50)/200). The precipitation term is needed because P/ET0 classifies cold polar deserts (very low ET0) as humid. Both from ERA5 1991-2020.

criteria.label: Ice / permafrost agreement - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'ice' (agreement). sim = 1 - |I_earth - I_ref|; I_ref = 1 if the reference has literature ice evidence (ground_ice / water_ice_cold_traps tag), else 0; I_earth = max(permafrost probability (Obu 2019, or ERA5-MAAT logistic model where Obu unavailable), WorldCover snow/ice fraction).

criteria.label: Abiotic (unvegetated) surface - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'abiotic_surface' (fraction). WorldCover bare/sparse + snow/ice fraction within 5 km (references are 100% unvegetated).

criteria.label: Fine-sediment (dust) similarity - Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions) (MOON-REF-01)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MOON-REF-01 on 'dust_sediment' (gaussian). SoilGrids 0-5 cm silt+clay vs reference fine fraction; only the Moon has a sourced value (≈50% by mass <60-80 um, wiki:Lunar regolith) -> approximated as 0.45 <50 um (derived, documented); Mars references are null so the feature drops out for Mars.

criteria.label: Resource match - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'resource' (jaccard).

criteria.label: Slope similarity - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'slope' (gaussian_pair). sim = 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dmed/4)^2) + 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dp90/6)^2); slopes compared at matched DEM baselines (Moon refs 80-118 m DEM vs Earth 90 m grid; Mars 463 m vs Earth 450 m grid)

criteria.label: Ruggedness (TRI) similarity - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'ruggedness' (log_ratio). sim = exp(-|ln(TRI_earth/TRI_ref)|), i.e. 0.5 at a factor-2 difference

criteria.label: Thermal similarity - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'thermal' (gaussian). Earth: CHELSA bio1 (fallback ERA5 mean) for surface sites; for lava-tube references the Earth value is the same air-temperature normal used as a proxy for cave interior temperature (documented approximation). Ref: literature/modeled mean surface temperature.

criteria.label: Aridity - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'aridity' (aridity_combined). References have no liquid precipitation (AI = 0, P = 0). sim = 0.5*sim_AI + 0.5*sim_P with sim_AI = 1 if AI<=0.05 (UNEP hyper-arid) else exp(-(AI-0.05)/0.15) and sim_P = 1 if P<=50 mm/yr else exp(-(P-50)/200). The precipitation term is needed because P/ET0 classifies cold polar deserts (very low ET0) as humid. Both from ERA5 1991-2020.

criteria.label: Ice / permafrost agreement - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'ice' (agreement). sim = 1 - |I_earth - I_ref|; I_ref = 1 if the reference has literature ice evidence (ground_ice / water_ice_cold_traps tag), else 0; I_earth = max(permafrost probability (Obu 2019, or ERA5-MAAT logistic model where Obu unavailable), WorldCover snow/ice fraction).

criteria.label: Abiotic (unvegetated) surface - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'abiotic_surface' (fraction). WorldCover bare/sparse + snow/ice fraction within 5 km (references are 100% unvegetated).

criteria.label: Fine-sediment (dust) similarity - Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains (MARS-REF-07)
criteria.description: 5 x TerraAnalog similarity of the Earth site to MARS-REF-07 on 'dust_sediment' (gaussian). SoilGrids 0-5 cm silt+clay vs reference fine fraction; only the Moon has a sourced value (≈50% by mass <60-80 um, wiki:Lunar regolith) -> approximated as 0.45 <50 um (derived, documented); Mars references are null so the feature drops out for Mars.

criteria.label: Operational test suitability (separate; weight 0)
criteria.description: TerraAnalog operational score / 20 (access 0.30, trafficability 0.20, climate workability 0.20, regulatory 0.15, infrastructure 0.15). Exported with body weight 0 so it is DISPLAYED but never mixed into fidelity.
criteria.earth_proxy: Natural Earth roads (upper-bound distance), Copernicus DEM slope, ERA5 monthly temperature, regulatory/infrastructure classes

objectives.label: General (equal feature weights)
objectives.description: All 11 TerraAnalog fidelity features weighted equally against the selected reference. Not a TerraAnalog mission profile; exploratory.

moon: Lunar gravity (about one-sixth of Earth's; wiki:Moon) - affects mobility, dust settling, drilling reaction forces and locomotion.
Hard vacuum - no convective cooling; outgassing and vacuum-specific material behaviour.
Permanently shadowed regions far colder than any Earth surface (Diviner: Paige et al. 2010, doi:10.1126/science.1187726).
Surface radiation environment without atmosphere or global magnetic field.
Lunar day/night length and illumination geometry at the poles.
mars: Martian gravity (lower than Earth's) - affects mobility, dust and locomotion.
Thin CO2 atmosphere - affects heat transfer, aerodynamics and dust lofting.
Surface radiation environment (no global magnetic field, thin atmosphere).
Earth sites are biologically active; planetary-protection conditions cannot be reproduced.
